settings.title: Bio-Identical Melatonin
settings.text: Described as the sleep hormone, melatonin declines with age. Topical melatonin helps reset the body's natural rhythm and acts as a powerful skin antioxidant.

settings.title: Improves Sleep Onset and Duration
settings.text: A 2022 systematic review and meta-analysis demonstrates that melatonin supplementation significantly enhances sleep onset latency and total sleep time among individuals with sleep disorders.

settings.title: Anti-Aging Skin Benefits
settings.text: Topically applied melatonin is a safe and effective skincare ingredient with antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, showing potential for photoprotection and anti-aging.
